# securitls_organization (Resource)

A SecuriTLS organization value used in certificate distinguished names.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "securitls_organization" "example" {
  name = "Example Corp"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Organization name (O=). SecuriTLS intentionally does not support renaming organizations.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String)
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
